overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('Windows Ctrl down : Boolean'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; added the documented Boolean return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns True if the Windows Ctrl key (Command key on Macintosh) is currently pressed.

constraints: On Macintosh, tests the Command key rather than a literal Ctrl key.
